title: fibigia rostrata
intro: Fibigia rostrata, commonly known as the Chinese onion flower or  rostrata onion, is a type of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Fibigia rostrata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to relieve symptoms of fever, cough, and digestive issues. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
